hook.en: Each musician in an orchestra may be brilliant, but without a conductor the music becomes noise. Coordination is the conductor of an organisation.
hook.kn: ವಾದ್ಯವೃಂದದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಕಲಾವಿದ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತನಾಗಿರಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ ವಾಹಕನಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸಂಗೀತ ಗದ್ದಲವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮನ್ವಯವೇ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ವಾಹಕ.

objectives.en: Explain why it is the essence of management

narration.en: Each musician in an orchestra may be brilliant, but without a conductor the music becomes noise. Coordination is the conductor of an organisation.
narration.kn: ವಾದ್ಯವೃಂದದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಕಲಾವಿದ ಪ್ರತಿಭಾವಂತನಾಗಿರಬಹುದು, ಆದರೆ ವಾಹಕನಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಸಂಗೀತ ಗದ್ದಲವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮನ್ವಯವೇ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ವಾಹಕ.

body.en: Coordination is the process by which a manager synchronises the activities of different departments so that the organisation acts as one. It integrates group efforts, ensures unity of action, is a continuous process, is all-pervasive, is the responsibility of all managers, and is a deliberate function: a manager must coordinate consciously even when people are willing to cooperate.

narration.en: Coordination is the process by which a manager synchronises the activities of different departments so that the organisation acts as one. It integrates group efforts, ensures unity of action, is a continuous process, is all-pervasive, is the responsibility of all managers, and is a deliberate function: a manager must coordinate consciously even when people are willing to cooperate.
narration.kn: ಸಮನ್ವಯ ಎಂದರೆ ವಿವಿಧ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸುವ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ಇದು ಗುಂಪಿನ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಗ್ಗೂಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ನಿರಂತರ, ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ ಮತ್ತು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರ ಜವಾಬ್ದಾರಿ.

body.en: As an organisation grows in size, the number of people and departments increases. Functional differentiation makes departments pursue their own goals, and specialisation makes specialists think they alone know best. Coordination ties all of these together. Since it is needed in every function and at every level, it is called the essence of management.

points.en: Needed at every level and in every function

narration.kn: ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಗಾತ್ರ, ಕಾರ್ಯ ವಿಭಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶೇಷೀಕರಣ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಂತೆ ಸಮನ್ವಯದ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಹಂತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುವುದರಿಂದ ಇದು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಸಾರ.

problem.en: A fan company's production department made 60,000 fans last quarter, but the sales department could sell only 45,000. What does this show, and how many fans are left unsold?

steps.en: That is 15,000 ÷ 60,000 × 100 = 25% of output lying in stock.
Production and sales worked towards different targets: their activities were not synchronised.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A fan company's production department made 60,000 fans last quarter, but the sales department could sell only 45,000. What does this show, and how many fans are left unsold?
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer. Let us see which team scores most.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ. ಯಾವ ತಂಡ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಕ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ನೋಡೋಣ.

narration.en: CBSE pattern questions: assertion-reason and case-based. Read the case first, then each statement.

points.en: Coordination synchronises the activities of all departments.
It is continuous, all-pervasive, deliberate and the job of all managers.
points.kn: ಇದು ನಿರಂತರ, ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ, ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕ ಮತ್ತು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರ ಕೆಲಸ.

points.en: It is the essence of management, not a separate function.

homework.en: Explain with an example why coordination is needed as an organisation grows.

narration.en: Recap. Coordination synchronises the activities of all departments. It is continuous, all-pervasive, deliberate and the job of all managers. It is the essence of management, not a separate function.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಮನ್ವಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳ ಚಟುವಟಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ನಿರಂತರ, ಸರ್ವವ್ಯಾಪಿ, ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕ ಮತ್ತು ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರ ಕೆಲಸ. ಇದು ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆಯ ಸಾರ, ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕಾರ್ಯವಲ್ಲ.
